name: slidekick
description: Make, edit and review fully editable, on-brand PowerPoint decks, checked against real PowerPoint and reviewed by fresh eyes.

interface.shortDescription: Brief in, editable on-brand PowerPoint out.
interface.longDescription: Turn a brief, documents, data, a code project or a website into a fully editable, on-brand .pptx with native text, charts, transitions and animations. Edit existing decks in place without breaking their formatting, and get a design critique of any presentation.
defaultPrompt: Make a 10-slide pitch deck from this project.
Update the numbers in this deck and keep its formatting.
Review this presentation and tell me what to fix.
